definitions.gloss: 80th birthday; celebration of one's eightieth year
definitions.explanation: A traditional celebration of a person's 80th birthday. The name comes from the cursive form of {傘|さん} (umbrella), which resembles the character {八十|はちじゅう} (eighty).

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{傘寿|さんじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
{傘寿|さんじゅ}のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食事会|しょくじかい}→食事会：23547_shokujikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: We held a family dinner to celebrate his eightieth birthday.

examples.japanese: {傘寿|さんじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えて→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧もなお、⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠|か}かさない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Even after turning eighty, my grandmother never misses her daily walk.

notes:
{傘寿|さんじゅ} celebrates a person's 80th birthday, one of the traditional Japanese longevity milestones (⟦{長寿|ちょうじゅ}→長寿：14478_chouju⟧のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧). The name comes from the cursive shorthand for {傘|さん} (umbrella), which looks like the character for eighty; the traditional celebratory color is gold or yellow.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傘寿|さんじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach one's eightieth year
- {傘寿|さんじゅ}のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧: an 80th-birthday celebration

TYPES:
Part of a sequence of longevity milestones: ⟦{古希|こき}→古希：29070_koki⟧ (70), ⟦{喜寿|きじゅ}→喜寿：29071_kiju⟧ (77), {傘寿|さんじゅ} (80), ⟦{米寿|べいじゅ}→米寿：30988_beiju⟧ (88), ⟦{卒寿|そつじゅ}→卒寿：30989_sotsuju⟧ (90), ⟦{白寿|はくじゅ}→白寿：30990_hakuju⟧ (99).
